anchors.a3: exists-but-citation-wrong: The correct citation is IEEE Micro, vol. 21, no. 1, pp. 24-36, January-February 2001 (not 2007)

sources.title: Physical Design of the POWER7 Processor
sources.what_it_covers: Timing closure challenges, clock-tree synthesis issues, and power-grid IR-drop recovery on IBM's POWER7 processor.
sources.why_relevant: First-hand account from IBM physical design engineers detailing specific signoff failures and how they were resolved before tapeout.
sources.verification_hint: "Physical Design of the POWER7" CICC IEEE

sources.title: The Design of the SPARC T4 Processor
sources.what_it_covers: Oracle/Sun's experience with routing congestion, floorplanning iterations, and timing closure at advanced nodes for a high-thread-count processor.
sources.why_relevant: Presents real-world congestion and placement war stories from a major commercial microprocessor team transitioning to new process nodes.

sources.title: A 28nm 32-Core Xeon Phi Processor
sources.what_it_covers: Power delivery network (PDN) design, EM/IR drop mitigation, and physical design challenges of integrating 32 cores on a single die.
sources.why_relevant: Details specific power-grid failures and the iterative physical-design fixes required to achieve silicon bring-up on Intel's Knights Corner.

sources.title: Apple M1 Architecture Deep Dive
sources.what_it_covers: Analysis of Apple's physical design choices, including cache SRAM density, floorplanning constraints, and power efficiency trade-offs that impacted layout.
sources.why_relevant: While primarily architectural, it discusses the physical design constraints and layout decisions that drove the chip's unprecedented performance-per-watt, reflecting closure trade-offs.
sources.verification_hint: AnandTech "Apple M1" deep dive Andrei Frumusanu

sources.title: Implementing RISC-V in Advanced Nodes
sources.what_it_covers: Practical challenges of PPA closure, standard-cell selection, and routing congestion when porting RISC-V designs to FinFET nodes.
sources.why_relevant: Provides modern, open-source-adjacent war stories about the physical design gap between RTL simulation and actual signoff closure at 16nm/7nm.
sources.verification_hint: RISC-V Summit SiFive "physical design" OR "advanced node" presentation

sources.title: OpenROAD: An Open-Source Physical Design Flow
sources.what_it_covers: Lessons learned from building an open-source place-and-route tool, including case studies of routing congestion and timing failures on open-source testcases.
sources.why_relevant: Documents specific failure modes in automated PnR flows and the algorithmic recoveries developed by the OpenROAD project to fix them.
